confidence_notes: Overall low. Meals rest on Munnar listing-site and blog ranges; coffee rests on one undated Munnar cafe menu (cappuccino INR 190). Beer relies on Kerala-wide restaurant reports, set slightly below the reported pint range for a smaller standard serving. Cocktail and wine had weak direct data (an undated bar menu and a forum remark; five-star menus excluded), so they are set at about 1.4x and 1.6x the beer anchor. Accommodation is a general-knowledge estimate for July monsoon low season, not from searches or live listings; hostel supply in Munnar is likely limited, so hostel anchors are least certain. INR converted at roughly 88-90 per USD from general knowledge, not searched. Drink anchors assume licensed venues, which are not universal in Munnar. The 2026-11-18 FX reading is the latest RBA observation found and was not checked against the published table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis is Kerala (Idukki district) food and drink price points. Accommodation is judged from general knowledge against other South Indian hill-station towns of similar scale, such as Ooty and Kodaikanal. No single comparable city was used.
